text: PRE-PROPOSAL HOLD on exact unregistered 245b01374d144deb8fb2f9477d73d9fb3f7d801f. Two executable blockers: (1) public BuildReceipt plus ExtendedBuildReceipt product data can be caller-minted, AcquisitionViewAuthority.validatedBuild checks only source StoryId/checksum, and AdmittedViewBasis then publishes ValidatedBuild authority without proof that a build ran or receipt/stage coherence; (2) a valid SourceOutcome.Refused(BeforeIntake, ...) result encodes but neither StoryOutputResultCodec.decode overload can decode it, because bare source decoding always refuses and contextual refused decoding requires progress.original. Exact-export temp attack suites passed 23/23 view and 10/10 codec, exit 0; evidence and source lines: post-01M1D8S6CG6KDQWZR5RN6A7SHS. Known-payload length mismatch was reproduced but is recorded only as a handoff-claim correction because the chief ruling requires known schema/checksum and byteLength only for unsupported payloads. No candidate or shared-source mutation.
